def: The protocol that defines how OpenTelemetry encodes, transports and delivers traces, metrics and logs between telemetry sources, collectors and backends, over gRPC or HTTP with Protobuf payloads.
practice: Default ports are 4317 (gRPC) and 4318 (HTTP), and exporting OTLP keeps you free to switch or combine LLM observability backends; the profiles signal is still in development as of November 2026.
